candidate_claim: AFCI (C4) lowers the dependency-direction violation rate relative to task-only prompting (C1)
direct_metric: dependency-direction violation rate per applicable frozen opportunity (numerator opportunity_accounting.violated_opportunity_count; offset opportunity_accounting.applicable_opportunity_count)
aggregation: Poisson/NB GLMM over E1-eligible tasks; task random effect; condition fixed; marginal contrast C4 vs C1
required_evidence: validated conformance oracle (G1); guard precision/recall (G6); powered independent runs; multiplicity-corrected contrast
unsupported_claim_risk: must not be restated as improved architectural integrity (CON-AI is broader and not directly measured) nor as broad architectural conformance (CON-ACB is not directly measured by E1)
notes: primary endpoint family; measures dependency direction only per RESEARCH_QUESTIONS CON-AC as narrowed by suite-classification decision D

candidate_claim: AFCI (C4) lowers the dependency-direction violation rate relative to token-matched generic guidance (C2)
direct_metric: dependency-direction violation rate per applicable frozen opportunity
aggregation: Poisson/NB GLMM over E1-eligible tasks; marginal contrast C4 vs C2
required_evidence: as CL01 plus verified C2/C4 token match within tolerance (TD-B08; G4)
unsupported_claim_risk: without a verified token match the effect could be token volume not architecture content
notes: isolates architecture content from token volume

candidate_claim: The C4-vs-C3 dependency-direction violation-rate relationship characterizes the delivery channel (persistent file vs governed injection); superiority equivalence or inferiority are all valid outcomes
direct_metric: dependency-direction violation rate per applicable frozen opportunity
aggregation: Poisson/NB GLMM over E1-eligible tasks; equivalence-aware/two-sided contrast C4 vs C3
required_evidence: as CL01 plus byte-identical MAD content across C3/C4 (G5; TD-B18); pre-registered equivalence margin (TD-B07; not from v1)
unsupported_claim_risk: treating a non-significant difference as proof of equivalence without an equivalence test; content is held byte-identical so the isolate is the delivery channel
notes: isolates delivery channel; C3 approx C4 is a valid supported outcome (D4); paper viability does not depend on C4 superiority

candidate_claim: Applicable-frozen-opportunity satisfaction proportion is reported as a descriptive transformation of the primary dependency-direction violation-rate endpoint (E1)
direct_metric: applicable-frozen-opportunity satisfaction proportion (descriptive transformation of E1)
secondary_metric: dependency-direction violation rate per applicable frozen opportunity
aggregation: descriptive summary over E1-eligible tasks; NOT an independent confirmatory contrast
required_evidence: G1; G6; ceiling/saturation check reported for interpretability
unsupported_claim_risk: presenting a descriptive transformation as an independent confirmatory endpoint; double-counting with E1
notes: descriptive transformation of the single primary endpoint E1 (D8); not independently confirmatory

candidate_claim: A controlled mid-task reset degrades direct conformance and completeness outcomes
direct_metric: reset main effect on a direct outcome (dependency-direction violation rate; hidden-test pass)
aggregation: GLMM with reset fixed effect over tasks
unsupported_claim_risk: a null degradation may reflect an ineffective or too-late checkpoint rather than true robustness
notes: reset main effect reported alongside the confirmatory interaction; reset is an experimental factor crossed with tasks not a task-content category

candidate_claim: AFCI (C4) attenuates reset-induced degradation more than the comparison conditions
direct_metric: condition x reset interaction on a direct outcome
aggregation: GLMM with condition x reset interaction; task random effect
required_evidence: valid checkpoints (G1/G2); equal budgets; power adequate for an interaction modelling pseudo-replication of shared boundary decisions (TD-B20; TD-B30); multiplicity correction
unsupported_claim_risk: interpreting a non-significant interaction as no effect (absence of evidence is not evidence of absence)
notes: interactions need more power than main effects

candidate_claim: AFCI (C4) increases the hidden acceptance-test pass proportion relative to C1/C2/C3
aggregation: binomial GLMM over tasks; contrasts C4 vs each comparison
required_evidence: hidden tests withheld from the model and shown discriminating (G1/G2); mutation/sanity checks
unsupported_claim_risk: visible-CI pass must not be used as completeness (gameable; v1 ci_pass saturated True)
notes: direct completeness metric per CON-TC; includes E1-ineligible functional-only tasks

candidate_claim: AFCI (C4) increases acceptance-criteria coverage relative to C1/C2/C3
direct_metric: acceptance-criteria coverage (per-criterion satisfied; supporting descriptive measure for E3)
aggregation: binomial GLMM over tasks (exploratory/supporting); reported alongside E3; not an independent confirmatory contrast
required_evidence: adjudicated criteria with oracle traceability (G1); inter-rater agreement for manual criteria
unsupported_claim_risk: partial-credit coverage can hide functional failure; pair with hidden-test pass; must not be treated as an independent confirmatory endpoint
notes: supporting/descriptive completeness measure (exploratory); confirmatory completeness endpoint is the hidden acceptance-test pass proportion (E3/CL07); reported alongside E3

candidate_claim: AFCI (C4) does not incur an unacceptable increase in change footprint relative to comparisons
secondary_metric: code churn; test churn; files changed (out-of-scope surface)
required_evidence: pre-registered unacceptable-cost tolerance (TD-B15); out-of-scope surface defined per task (TASK_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX)
unsupported_claim_risk: change footprint is not architectural drift and not integrity; Delta-CodeLOC is not drift
notes: secondary change-footprint metric; can only qualify a gain never establish one

candidate_claim: AFCI (C4) does not incur an unacceptable increase in tokens/time/verification iterations relative to comparisons
secondary_metric: tokens; execution time; verification iterations (CI attempts)
unsupported_claim_risk: efficiency claims without a pre-registered tolerance are post-hoc

candidate_claim: After AFCI adoption at FGC objective review and delivery measures improved
direct_metric: review rounds; architecture-related review comments; time to first approval; time to merge; PR size (pre vs post)
aggregation: pre/post comparison with confounder adjustment; effect sizes with 95% CIs
required_evidence: raw-record availability and minimum interpretable sample (G7); confound/task-type/urgency audit; anonymization
unsupported_claim_risk: observational before/after cannot establish causation; confounding by concurrent changes

candidate_claim: Practitioner perceptions of AFCI agree or diverge from the objective FGC measures
aggregation: descriptive; reported side-by-side with objective measures (never merged)
required_evidence: survey instrument and response provenance; the objective measures from CL11
unsupported_claim_risk: perception is not objective evidence and must be labelled as perception unless objectively verified

direct_metric: none (not directly measured by any single metric)
secondary_metric: converging CON-AC + CON-ACB + CON-TC + CON-RR evidence
aggregation: qualitative synthesis across pre-registered confirmatory results
required_evidence: converging pre-registered evidence across constructs plus final-claim audit (G8)
unsupported_claim_risk: HIGH - dependency-direction conformance CI pass and Delta-CodeLOC are NOT architectural integrity; do not claim directly measured
notes: guardrail claim; must not be marked supported without G8 (see RESEARCH_QUESTIONS CON-AI)

candidate_claim: The v2 conformance oracle and guard validly and reliably measure dependency-direction conformance
direct_metric: guard precision and recall on a labelled violation corpus
required_evidence: labelled violation/clean corpus; mutation tests including violations introduced in NEW files (G6; TD-B27); alias-aware rule matching; exact-path opportunity-attribution validation
unsupported_claim_risk: an unvalidated guard invalidates every conformance claim (the v1 guard was blind to @afci-bench/* aliases); exact-path attribution may miss a violation introduced in a new file

candidate_claim: Broader architectural conformance dimensions are NOT directly measured by the primary automated endpoint and are reported as secondary/manual evidence only
direct_metric: none (deliberately not directly measured by E1)
secondary_metric: manual rubric ratings for contract ownership; port/interface placement; observability completeness; duplicated logic; general business-logic placement
unit_of_analysis: run (one patch) adjudicated per rubric dimension
aggregation: descriptive per dimension; confirmatory use only under blinded double rating with Cohen kappa >= 0.70; never pooled into E1
required_evidence: MANUAL_RATING_PROTOCOL blinded double rating with Cohen kappa >= 0.70 (TD-B12; G6); unimplemented oracle stubs must report UNIMPLEMENTED and never PASS
unsupported_claim_risk: HIGH - describing E1 as broad or general architectural conformance; pooling manual dimensions into the E1 numerator or denominator; treating stub rules as measured
notes: guardrail claim recording the narrowed construct (suite-classification decision D); implementing AR-CONTRACT-001 or AR-CODE-001 is future work to broaden E1 not to readmit an excluded task post hoc (TD-B33)
